intro: The complete guide to getting your TIE residency card in Barcelona.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.description: Sign up with your Google account to get started.

steps.title: Complete your personal information
steps.description: Enter your passport details, visa information, and address.

steps.title: Accept Legal and Privacy
steps.description: Review and accept our terms and privacy policy.

steps.title: Pay for VisaMesa
steps.description: One-time payment to unlock all features.

steps.title: Register your address
steps.description: Get empadronamiento at your local Ayuntamiento.

steps.title: Book fingerprint appointment
steps.description: Secure a cita previa slot on the official police website.

steps.title: Fill your EX-17 form
steps.description: Review your TIE application form before printing.

steps.title: Pay the TIE fee
steps.description: Print Modelo 790 and pay at a Spanish bank.

steps.title: Attend fingerprint appointment
steps.description: Go to the police station with all your documents.

steps.title: Collect your TIE
steps.description: Return with your resguardo and passport to pick up your card.

steps.title: Your TIE is complete
steps.description: Keep your card safe and note the expiry date.
